items.question: Why do I need to build a personal brand?
items.answer: People buy from people they recognise and trust. A strong personal brand puts you in front of buyers before your first message, makes your outreach credible and gives you pricing power: 45% of a company's market value ties back to leadership reputation, and buyers pay 13.57x more to those they see as experts.

items.question: Why LinkedIn?
items.answer: LinkedIn is where you can reach named decision-makers directly, by role, company and seniority. Personal profiles get far more reach than company pages, so content from you builds trust while outreach starts the conversations, and both happen in the same place your buyers already check before replying.

items.question: What's in it for me?
items.answer: A steady pipeline of conversations and qualified meetings, a profile and content that make your outreach credible, and a calendar that fills consistently, for about 90 minutes of your time a month. That time goes into one content interview and reviewing what we write; we handle the rest.

items.question: How do AI agents fit into the process?
items.answer: They work like a research team in the background. They break down your ICP, rank who is most likely to engage, enrich every lead with context, track your competitors, and draft comments, replies and follow-ups in your voice. Our team reviews their output before anything goes out under your name.

items.question: What makes AI agents so effective for LinkedIn?
items.answer: LinkedIn rewards relevance. Agents work from current data, so each connection request, InMail and follow-up reaches the right person with the right context, at a volume a manual team cannot match. People still set the strategy and review the messages, so the voice stays yours.

items.question: How much time do I need to spend as a founder?
items.answer: About 90 minutes a month. We handle the research, content writing, outreach, replies to comments and reporting around that input, so your time goes into the conversations and meetings the work produces rather than into producing content or chasing leads.

items.question: How does Myntmore help me stand out from the competition?
items.answer: We track how often your competitors post, what works for them and where they fall short, then position you a step ahead with sharper messaging and content. The aim is that when a buyer compares you with alternatives on LinkedIn, your profile and posts answer their questions first.

items.question: What makes Myntmore different from other agencies?
items.answer: Most agencies stop at profile optimisation, content and reporting. We also run ICP research, LinkedIn and InMail lead generation, multi-channel sequences with cold email, competitor and buyer intelligence, and AI agent-led prospecting, with weekly pipeline updates and a monthly strategy review. You get one team for content and outreach.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: Not on day one. The first weeks go into setting up your profile, defining the audience and publishing consistent content. Most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4, and traction builds from there as content and outreach start working together.

items.question: I might not have enough content to share. How will you generate that?
items.answer: That is our job. We plan a monthly content strategy, write the posts and use a short video interview with you to capture your ideas, stories and opinions. You review everything before it is published, so you never need a backlog of content and every post still sounds like you.
